summary.zh: agent-pack：被启动器包装的 MCP 条目引用 ${PLUGIN_ROOT}（包内 Skill 路径等）或 ${PLUGIN_DATA} 时能正常启动，不再报 credential env file missing key: PLUGIN_ROOT；启动器按自身位置推导包根，PLUGIN_DATA 由客户端展开后经 --plugin-data 传入。
summary.en: agent-pack: launcher-wrapped MCP entries that reference ${PLUGIN_ROOT} (e.g. package Skill paths) or ${PLUGIN_DATA} now start correctly instead of failing with 'credential env file missing key: PLUGIN_ROOT'; the launcher derives the package root from its own location and receives PLUGIN_DATA from the client via --plugin-data.
